integrity: The proof is exact. The universal lower bound is a two-point matrix certificate valid for every positive-definite quadratic pullback; the upper bound is verified by exact edgewise minimization on the actual octagonal unit ball. No numerical sampling is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the canonical piecewise-linear nonabsolute generalized Day--James octagon and does not classify arbitrary generalized Day--James planes or all optimal linear maps. Originality is supported by targeted semantic and exact-expression searches but cannot exclude an unindexed specialist source.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance of the canonical nonabsolute Day--James octagon
